reasoning_checks: Operating versus common-equity numerators are matched to claimholders, consolidated earnings, dates and excluded income. Market NCI is added for the full subsidiary denominator and deducted to return to parent common equity; separately held assets without denominator income are removed from operating value.

Financial debt excludes the separately listed lease claim. Capitalized-lease EV is paired with earnings before all lease payments and includes the related assets, depreciation and renewal investment in DCF. The complete after-rent alternative is distinguished from two inconsistent mixed ratios.

The justified forward multiple is derived from first future NOPAT, supported end-year investment and a geometric FCFF path. Growth sensitivity holds first earnings fixed and changes reinvestment. The sign depends on R minus r, with a separate opening-capital base when R itself changes.

D&A is not equated universally to maintenance capex; EBITDA is not treated as cash available for financing. Margin, tax, capital intensity and reinvestment conditions remain explicit. Equity payout and operating reinvestment ratios are not interchanged.

Original claim and normalization tables contain every candidate and target. The primary rule has no price cutoff. P5's operating model and P6's unsupported negative-profit state are disclosed; their exclusion is not evidence that relevant failure risk disappears.

Accounting/lease alignment, genuinely isolated settled costs and gains, cycle normalization and future capacity are shown separately. Recurring warranty, compensation and other necessary costs remain expenses. All transitory settlements precede T0, and resulting cash is already in the claim table.

Prices and claims use one T0 after distributions; all forward denominators cover Y1. Original Y0 and Y1 are fictional relative dates, not observed calendar-market data. A normal annual denominator is not automatically a next-year forecast; transition cash and available-information dates matter.

Median, equal-company mean and pooled ratio answer different aggregation questions. The pooled identity is proved with positive denominator weights. Four leave-one-out results expose sample fragility without turning a peer span into a confidence interval.

Morrow's raw 385/80 ratio is 4.8125 while its normalized forward ratio is 7.7. Applying the peers' forward median to the raw subtotal overstates the same-method operating and equity result by 210; this is a denominator mismatch, not a price movement.

The EV/EBIT median produces 390 versus EBITDA-median 350 and DCF 400. These differences are traced to earnings/capital measurement and conditional cash/risk assumptions; no unexplained average is presented as additional evidence.

The DCF is independently reconstructed as opening capital plus future economic profit. Conditional rates 69/700 and 711/7700 hold first FCFF and g fixed and are not called independent risk estimates. A peer-multiple terminal value would share the original price assumptions.

Transaction values distinguish standalone operations, feasible synergies, integration costs, control and bargaining. Exercise 8 explicitly assumes all net synergy is reflected in price before deriving the standalone component, avoiding an unconditional inference from consideration alone.

All eight prompts were matched to complete answers for data, timing, claim boundary and methods taught earlier. Open peer/evidence judgments have explicit criteria. EPS and aggregate P/E are allowed to differ only because current and weighted-average share bases differ; a consistently adjusted split changes neither ratio nor equity capitalization.

Ratios 6/8/11, median 8, mean 25/3, pooled 151/16 with explicit weights; median equity 200 and pooled equity 1945/8, shares 12 thousand.

Adding P5 or removing P4 lowers median to 6 for different reasons; negative P6 ratio is nonrankable. Economic rule, full disclosure, original/revised sensitivity and evidence criteria supplied.

source_checks.inspection: Actual author-hosted anatomy, relevant EV/claims definitions, complete normalization and comparability bodies, and official SEC 100.01–100.06/103.01–103.02 passages read at recorded scopes.
source_checks.limits: No source company example, historical market ratio or current issuer observation is copied. The comparability source's unnecessary predictor-independence claim and historical confidence/R-squared claims are not adopted; a universal normalization-window or discount-back rule is not asserted.
source_checks.jurisdiction: SEC discussion is limited to the cited U.S. staff interpretations as retrieved on 2026-10-08, with their stated revision dates; fictional operating subtotals are not claimed as regulated or audited disclosures.
source_checks.originality: All prose, Morrow/peer inputs, cases, exercises, numerical paths, benchmark and independent checker are original.

resolved_findings.finding: The conditional implied-rate comparison needs positive operating price and continuing cash; a zero-price or zero-distribution edge would not identify the stated rate.
resolved_findings.resolution: Bounded lab requires positive operating EV, positive target reported subtotal and g strictly below ROIC as well as r. General chapter formula retains its separately stated zero-cash boundary. README states the lab's tighter comparison domain.

limitations: All price, claim, normalization, cycle and discount inputs are fictional assumptions. Code cannot authenticate actual comparability, economic recurrence, future recovery, market value or risk.

The small industrial positive-profit lab is not an issuer data service, general lease/reporting conversion, distress model or complete financial-statement reconstruction. It begins from supplied operating subtotals.
Excluded firms remain visible; the positive-profit cohort does not establish that the target lacks their downside risk. No regression, confidence interval or arbitrage-profit claim is made.

Author and agent review are not independent human academic certification or a guarantee of error-free valuation. Coordinator owns prerequisite acceptance, full shared build/link checks and publication.
Browser, mobile and print visual QA are separate and not claimed by these structural and arithmetic checks.
